fatal_errors: The proposed coherent-nanoprecipitate mechanism is not evidenced for the target as-cast WTaTiVZr alloy, whose observed structural mediator was a segregated two-BCC-phase dendritic microstructure rather than coherent nanoprecipitates.
Area under a tensile stress-strain curve is not equivalent to fracture toughness, so the proposed experiment cannot substantiate the claimed improvement in crack resistance or KC.

The SCCP treatment may alter grain structure, phase fractions, segregation, and residual stresses in addition to precipitation, so the comparison does not by itself isolate precipitate coherence as the causal variable.
explanation: This is a scientifically plausible alternative based on directly relevant literature about coherent nanoprecipitation in tungsten refractory high-entropy alloys, but it does not reconstruct the hidden study. The target compared as-cast equimolar WTaTiVZr with coarse-grained powder-sintered pure tungsten under compression, indentation through 500 °C, and room-temperature scratch testing. Its interpreted mechanisms involved multicomponent solid-solution strengthening, lattice distortion, elemental effects on dislocation behavior and cohesion, and crack deflection or localization associated with a segregated two-BCC-phase dendritic microstructure. The generated hypothesis instead introduces an unreported SCCP treatment, uses an isocompositional untreated alloy as baseline, extends testing to 800 °C, and assigns control to coherent nanoprecipitates. E1 supports coherent interfaces, ambient tensile ductility, and elevated-temperature strength in another tungsten RHEA, but it does not establish high-temperature plastic strain or fracture toughness and therefore only partially supports the full claim. TEM plus matched mechanical testing is useful, but causal discrimination would require controlling other heat-treatment-induced microstructural changes and directly measuring crack-growth or fracture toughness. The boundary is also too broad because precipitate stability, irradiation, thermal cycling, and actual plasma-facing service were not addressed.
